 The Four M1 Insurance Group guides beneficiaries through their Medicare open enrollment options
 Megan Huiskens , Josh Monroe 10-28-2026 at 04:00:00 PM EDT | Updated 10-28-2026 at 04:11:46 PM EDT Link Copied! Medicare open enrollment is underway as an estimated 115,000 residents in Michigan face the loss of their current health plans for the upcoming year.
 Debbie Stroup, Vice President of Operations for M1 Insurance Group, advised Medicare beneficiaries to review their coverage options rather than assuming existing plans will remain unchanged.
 “Right now is the perfect time to look at all of your doctors and your prescriptions and your pharmacy,” Stroup said. “Make sure that they’re all in network for next year.”
 Advertisement Healthcare needs differ for each individual household members which can require different plans based on their specific doctors and medications.
 “We take all of your doctors and prescriptions and I research them to make sure that they’re in network for you, because if they’re not, more money comes out of your pocket,” Stroup said.
 In addition, Stroup cautioned beneficiaries against sales calls from telemarketers. She advised residents to avoid choosing plans based solely on surface-level perks like grocery or dental allowances, emphasizing that network coverage for core health care providers is paramount. 
 “When those solicitors are calling you, I know you’re getting nine or 10 calls a day,” Stroup said. “Hang up on them. Don’t listen to them... the most important thing is that your doctor and your prescriptions are in network.”
 Advertisement M1 Insurance Group operates as an independent agency licensed by the federal government to offer guidance without cost to clients. 
 “There is no cost for our service and the really unique thing about us is we’re completely independent,” Stroup said. “When you get that bill in March and you’re like, oh my gosh, I don’t know what this means. You call us and we will work through it with you and help find answers,” Stroup said.
 Medicare beneficiaries seeking assistance can reach licensed representatives at M1 Insurance Group by phone or through the company’s website during the open enrollment period.
 For more information, visit m1insurancegroup.com .
